modelo-cinema.luz: The overall scene is dimly lit, with a warm, low-key light source illuminating the subject-related image, creating soft shadows and depth.
modelo-cinema.papeisDasCores: A dark background color dominates, light text provides high contrast, and a warm accent color is used sparingly for emphasis, line art, and credit-like text.
modelo-cinema.evitar: Do not include any bright glows behind the subject, light leaks, film scratches, emojis, text outlines, or colorful gradients. Avoid any UI elements or empty frames.

modelo-clinico.atmosfera: Precise, analytical, and clean. This style evokes the feeling of a detailed medical examination or a scientific presentation.
modelo-clinico.elementoVisual: A schematic illustration or diagram, rendered with clean lines and subtle fills, serves as the central visual. It can be an anatomical drawing, a technical cutaway, or an abstract representation of a concept, with key areas highlighted or outlined. This element directly relates to the hero sentence, illustrating its core idea.
composicoes: Hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with the visual element filling the upper two-thirds of the post, slightly off-center.
Hero text is positioned in a prominent top-left block, while the visual element occupies the rest of the canvas, rendered at a medium scale with ample negative space.
The visual element is large and centered, with the hero text integrated within its form or placed in a clear, contrasting block directly below it.
Hero text is presented in a narrow vertical column on the left, with the visual element dominating the right side of the post, shown in a detailed, close-up view.
The visual element is a small, focused detail, placed in the upper right, with the hero text filling the majority of the post in a large, bold arrangement.
modelo-clinico.tipografia: A single, clean geometric sans-serif family is used. Key words and main titles are in a heavy weight, while supporting text and labels use a medium to semi-bold weight, with consistent, slightly condensed tracking. Hierarchy is established through size and weight variations.
modelo-clinico.textura: Surfaces are smooth and clean, with occasional subtle light-cool paper grain for diagrams or a faint grid pattern in the background, suggesting technical precision.
modelo-clinico.luz: The scene is evenly lit with a cool, bright light, creating minimal shadows and emphasizing clarity and detail.
modelo-clinico.papeisDasCores: A light, cool background dominates, with dark text for readability. A primary accent color is used for outlines, numbers, and correct indicators, while a contrasting accent color is reserved exclusively for error or warning indicators.
modelo-clinico.evitar: Do not include any photographic elements, gradients, drop shadows, or overly decorative flourishes. Avoid any elements that suggest movement or video playback, such as progress bars or play buttons.

modelo-constelacao.atmosfera: An academic, premium, and precise mood, reminiscent of vintage scientific atlases. It evokes a sense of discovery and guided exploration.
modelo-constelacao.elementoVisual: A stylized, flat celestial map forms the background, featuring a subtle grid, dotted star fields, and a graduated border. Ideas are rendered as glowing points of light, connected by thin lines, forming abstract constellations that visually interpret the hero sentence.
composicoes: Hero text is large and centered on the lower half, with a subject-related abstract texture filling a prominent round frame in the upper right, balanced by ample negative space.
Hero text is positioned in a narrow left column, with the abstract constellation visual element filling the entire right side of the post, viewed from a wide perspective.

Hero text is small and placed at the top, while a large, detailed abstract constellation, viewed from a close perspective, dominates the center, with a round subject-related texture in the lower left.
Hero text is integrated within the abstract constellation lines in the center, with a round subject-related texture in the upper left, leaving the bottom clear.
Hero text is large and at the bottom, with the abstract constellation visual element filling the entire upper two-thirds of the post, featuring a round subject-related texture in the upper right.
modelo-constelacao.tipografia: A high-contrast serif typeface like Spectral is used for the main hero text, with key words in a heavier weight or italic. A wide-tracked uppercase geometric sans like Reddit Sans is used for any secondary, smaller text, maintaining clear hierarchy.
modelo-constelacao.textura: The background features a subtle, dark, almost-black surface with a fine coordinate grid, faint dotted patterns suggesting a star field, and a dark vignette at the edges. Surfaces are flat with no visible grain.
modelo-constelacao.luz: The scene is lit with a single, focused light source that highlights the glowing elements, creating a strong contrast against the dark background, with no ambient light.
modelo-constelacao.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, with light, warm text and glowing elements. A single accent color is used sparingly for guiding lines and focal points.
modelo-constelacao.evitar: Do not use any photos, colored gradients, text outlines, or any visual elements that appear to be shaking or flashing. Avoid any element that looks like a price tag, sign, or screen.

modelo-conversa.atmosfera: Modern, clean, and premium, evoking the familiar intimacy of a well-designed messaging app. It feels immediate and direct, like a personal exchange.
modelo-conversa.elementoVisual: Stylized line art icons or abstract shapes, rendered with clean, single-stroke outlines and flat fills. These elements are generic and adaptable, illustrating concepts like success, failure, or a shared item, and are integrated into the message bubble or as a card.
composicoes: Hero text centered within a large message bubble, which is placed over a dark background with a subtle, subject-related texture filling the lower half of the frame.
Hero text in a narrow column on the left, with a large, abstract visual element filling the right two-thirds of the frame, rendered as a shared card.
Hero text as a 'fixed message' at the top, with a series of smaller message bubbles below it, each containing a simple line art icon or a short phrase, all over a dark background.
Hero text large and central, with a prominent line art icon or abstract shape behind it, slightly transparent, filling the middle of the frame, all on a dark background.
Hero text at the bottom right, contained within a message bubble, with a large, subject-related texture filling the entire background, and a small, subtle line art icon in the top left.
modelo-conversa.tipografia: A highly legible geometric sans-serif, like Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, is used throughout. Text in message bubbles uses a medium weight, while titles and highlights use bold to extra-bold weights, all in mixed case with standard tracking.
modelo-conversa.textura: The background features a very subtle, dark, uniform texture, like a fine grain or brushed metal, providing depth without distraction. Message bubbles are flat and opaque.
modelo-conversa.luz: The scene is evenly lit with a soft, ambient light, creating minimal shadows and maintaining a clean, digital aesthetic.
modelo-conversa.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, with light text for readability. The accent color is used for key messages, highlights, and success indicators, providing a warm contrast.
modelo-conversa.evitar: Do not use any gradients, bright glows, outlined letters, or complex photographic elements. Avoid any elements that mimic real-world UI like price tags or screens, or empty frames.

modelo-convite.atmosfera: Refined, calm, and premium, evoking the timeless feel of bespoke paper goods. It suggests a curated experience, like receiving a cherished invitation.
modelo-convite.elementoVisual: A subject-related image, scene, or texture fills an arch-shaped frame, resembling a fine art print or a detailed illustration. This arch-framed element is presented as a central piece of a stationery suite, often accompanied by smaller, stacked cards.
composicoes: The hero text is large and centered at the bottom of a prominent arch-framed visual element, which dominates the upper two-thirds of the post.

The hero text is a large, calligraphic header on a smaller card, which is stacked with other cards on one side, while the arch-framed visual element is scaled down and positioned on the opposite side.
The hero text is a prominent number on a circular dial, positioned centrally, with the arch-framed visual element scaled down to a corner and a satin ribbon element stretching across the background.
The hero text is a short phrase on a card, which is one of several fanned-out cards, all partially visible beneath a large, arch-framed visual element that fills most of the post.

The hero text is a single line of text at the top of a card, which is the largest element, with the arch-framed visual element scaled small and placed in the bottom corner, leaving significant negative space.
modelo-convite.tipografia: Key words use an elegant, flowing script typeface, while numbers and short labels are rendered in a wide-tracked, uppercase serif with a chiseled appearance. Body text and longer phrases use a classic, readable serif with moderate weight and occasional italics, ensuring clarity and sophistication.
modelo-convite.textura: The background features a fine linen weave, providing a soft, tactile base. Cards have a subtle cotton paper grain, and a smooth, reflective satin ribbon element may be present.
modelo-convite.luz: Soft, diffused light originates from the top-left, casting gentle, subtle shadows that enhance the dimensionality of the paper elements and create a calm atmosphere.
modelo-convite.papeisDasCores: A cool, light background dominates, with dark text providing strong contrast. A single, rich accent color is used sparingly for specific elements like a wax seal, a dial, or small decorative shapes, never tinting images.
modelo-convite.evitar: Do not include any decorative gradients, metallic effects, or glowing elements behind the visual element. Avoid outlines on text, emojis, stickers, or any stock photography that would detract from the refined, handcrafted aesthetic.

modelo-criativo.atmosfera: Modern, clean, and highly structured. It conveys a premium, trustworthy, and direct sales message through precise visual hierarchy.
modelo-criativo.elementoVisual: A central 'glass stage' composed of translucent, layered glass cards with subtle depth and a soft glow. These cards display a subject-related image, scene, or texture, which can be a hero product, a demonstrative photo, or an illustrative icon.
composicoes: The hero text is large and centered at the top, with a prominent glass card below it filling the lower two-thirds of the post, showcasing a subject-related image at a medium scale.
The hero text is positioned in a narrow column on the left, while a full-height glass card on the right displays a large-scale subject-related image, creating strong negative space on the left.
The hero text is small and placed at the bottom, with a large glass card occupying the entire upper portion of the post, featuring a subject-related image at a wide, expansive viewpoint.
The hero text is centered over a large, slightly tilted glass card that fills most of the post, with the subject-related image integrated within the card at a medium scale.
The hero text is placed at the top right, with a smaller, square glass card in the bottom left corner showcasing a close-up subject-related image, leaving significant negative space.
modelo-criativo.tipografia: A single geometric sans-serif typeface, Sora, is used across all text elements. Key words and headlines are rendered in extra bold (800) with tight tracking, while supporting text uses bold (700) or semi-bold (600) weights with standard tracking.
modelo-criativo.textura: Surfaces are predominantly smooth, translucent glass with a subtle blur effect, a faint light border, and a soft highlight on the upper left corner, suggesting depth and a premium feel.
modelo-criativo.luz: The scene is evenly lit, with soft, ambient light that highlights the glass elements and their subtle shadows, creating a clean and focused presentation.
modelo-criativo.papeisDasCores: The background is a dark, cool tone, while text on glass cards is a contrasting light tone. A single accent color, either a warm signal tone or the client's brand color, is used for key words and graphic elements.
modelo-criativo.evitar: Do not use generic stock photos that only 'somewhat' match the subject, or different products across multiple layouts. Never place text over the edge of a glass card or use any real brand logos.

modelo-curriculo.atmosfera: A focused and authentic aesthetic, reminiscent of a professional document review. It conveys a serious, educational, and premium feel through its analog, paper-based visual language.
modelo-curriculo.elementoVisual: A clean, flat document page, appearing as if laid on a desk. This page is filled with generic, unreadable text lines and placeholder sections, representing a subject-related document. The page is the primary canvas for the hero text and handwritten annotations.
composicoes: The hero text is large and centered on the document page, with the page slightly zoomed in to fill most of the frame.
The hero text is positioned in a prominent top section of the document page, with a smaller, subject-related image filling a paper-like adhesive note on the right margin, pointing to the text.
The hero text is placed in a bottom section of the document page, with the page zoomed in, and a wide, subject-related image filling a paper-like adhesive note at the bottom of the frame.
The hero text is presented as a large question at the top of the frame, with the document page visible below it, and a large, subject-related image filling a paper-like adhesive note above the page.
The hero text is integrated directly into the document's content, with key phrases highlighted by handwritten marks, and the document page filling the entire frame.
modelo-curriculo.tipografia: The document uses an elegant, high-contrast serif typeface for main body text, titles, and numbers, with varying weights for hierarchy. Section titles and labels use a wide-tracked uppercase geometric sans-serif, while all annotations and highlights are rendered in a distinct, informal handwritten script.
modelo-curriculo.textura: The scene features a subtle paper texture for the document and any adhesive notes, with soft shadows suggesting depth and slight curling at the edges of the notes. The background has a cool, smooth surface texture.
modelo-curriculo.luz: The scene is evenly lit with soft, diffused light, creating gentle shadows that define the paper elements without harsh contrasts.
modelo-curriculo.papeisDasCores: The background is a cool dark tone, the document page is light, and adhesive notes are a slightly warmer light tone. The primary text is dark, while all accent marks and handwritten annotations are a single, vibrant accent color.
modelo-curriculo.evitar: Do not include any colorful gradients, glowing effects, text outlines, emojis, or colored highlighters. Avoid any interface elements like app icons, speech bubbles, or flash transitions.

modelo-demo.atmosfera: Modern, functional, and highly informative. This style conveys a premium yet accessible feel, suitable for demonstrating concepts or products.
modelo-demo.elementoVisual: The core visual element is a clean, full-bleed digital interface or a subject-related photographic scene, rendered flat or with subtle depth. It serves as a direct visual representation of the hero text's idea, filling the designated area completely.
composicoes: Hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with a full-bleed digital interface filling the top 44% of the canvas and a dark background below.
Hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with a full-bleed digital interface or subject image occupying the entire 4:5 canvas.
Hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with a full-bleed subject-related photographic scene occupying the entire 4:5 canvas, viewed from a slightly closer perspective.

Hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with a full-bleed digital interface or subject image occupying the top 44% of the canvas, and a thin accent strip centered at the interface's bottom edge.
Hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with a full-bleed digital interface or subject image occupying the entire 4:5 canvas, featuring a prominent cursor icon pointing to a key area.
modelo-demo.tipografia: The hero text uses a condensed display sans-serif in uppercase, with a dark outline and shadow for strong contrast. Supporting text within the visual element uses a wide geometric sans-serif, typically in a bold weight and light color.
modelo-demo.textura: Surfaces are clean and digital, with no visible grain or paper texture. Depth is minimal, primarily conveyed through subtle shadows on text elements.
modelo-demo.luz: The lighting is even and bright on the visual element, mimicking a screen display or well-lit scene, with a dark, uniform background providing contrast.
modelo-demo.papeisDasCores: A very dark background dominates, with light text for readability. A single vibrant accent color is used sparingly for emphasis, and the hero text uses a warm, medium-value color with a dark outline.
modelo-demo.evitar: Do not use filters, vignettes, blur, or color overlays on any photographic elements. Avoid animated zooms, emojis, or any hand-drawn interface elements.

modelo-devocional.atmosfera: This style evokes a calm, reflective mood, like a cherished page from a devotional book. It feels premium and timeless, designed for quiet contemplation.
modelo-devocional.elementoVisual: The primary visual elements are simple, fine line-art illustrations that literally depict a key word from the sentence, or a subject-related texture or scene filling the lower frame. These elements are rendered with clean, minimal strokes or as a subtle, ambient background.
composicoes: The hero text is centered vertically on a large page, with a subtle line-art illustration appearing above it, scaled to fit the top half of the page.
The hero text is positioned in the upper half of the page, with a large, abstract texture or scene filling the entire lower half of the post.
A single, large line-art illustration dominates the center of the page, with the hero text placed compactly in a clear area within its negative space.
The hero text is aligned to the left, occupying the middle third of the page, with a small, detailed line-art drawing positioned as an accent in the upper right corner.
The hero text is presented in a prominent, large scale in the center of the page, with a subtle, subject-related texture filling the entire background.
modelo-devocional.tipografia: EB Garamond (a high-contrast serif) is used for all main text, with varying weights (medium for body, semibold for emphasis) and generous line spacing. Titles and references use a custom small caps style (Manrope, a wide geometric sans, is reserved for minor branding elements not present in the still post).
modelo-devocional.textura: The background features a subtle, warm light-toned paper texture with a gentle, slow drift, suggesting an aged parchment. Fine dust motes are visible, softly illuminated.
modelo-devocional.luz: The scene is lit by a soft, warm light source that subtly shifts across the background, creating gentle highlights and shadows, especially behind emphasized text.
modelo-devocional.papeisDasCores: A warm light background dominates, with dark text and a muted accent color used for ornaments, emphasized words, and line-art illustrations.
modelo-devocional.evitar: Do not include any metallic effects, strong light rays, angelic imagery, crosses, doves, stained glass, baroque frames, or cloud-filled sky backgrounds. Avoid any text with shadows or overly bright, contrasting elements.

modelo-dicionario.atmosfera: Scholarly, authoritative, and premium. Evokes the classic feel of a well-bound, informative book.
modelo-dicionario.elementoVisual: A stylized, subject-related illustration or texture fills the area where the presenter would be. This element is rendered with clean lines, ink-like shading, and cross-hatching, resembling a technical drawing or an engraving, without any specific subject matter.
composicoes: Hero text is a large title word, centered, with a smaller definition below, while the visual element is a framed illustration in the top right, with ample negative space.
Hero text is a single large word on the left, with a struck-out phrase and a correct phrase below, while the visual element is a framed illustration in the top left, leaving the right side for text.
Hero text is a numbered list of definitions, occupying the main content area, with the visual element as a small framed illustration at the top center, and guide words at the top corners.
Hero text is a short sentence in a narrow column on the right, with a large, abstract visual element filling the entire left side of the post, resembling a full-page engraving.
Hero text is a single, very large word centered on the page, with the visual element as a subtle, abstract texture filling the background behind the text, creating depth.
modelo-dicionario.tipografia: A high-contrast serif typeface is used for all main text, with bold weights for keywords and titles, and italics for supporting details. A wide-tracked uppercase geometric sans-serif is reserved for numbers, labels, and small informational text, maintaining a clear hierarchy.
modelo-dicionario.textura: The background features a subtle, warm paper texture, with a soft shadow near one edge, suggesting a book's spine. All graphic elements appear as if printed with ink, with no glossy or digital effects.
modelo-dicionario.luz: The scene is evenly lit, as if under natural ambient light, with soft, subtle shadows only where paper overlaps paper, creating a sense of physical depth.
modelo-dicionario.papeisDasCores: A light background dominates, with dark text and supporting elements. A single, rich accent color is used sparingly for emphasis on keywords, page numbers, and decorative elements.
modelo-dicionario.evitar: Do not include any photos, flags, emojis, or gradient effects. Avoid any elements that would require additional text beyond the provided sentence, such as price tags or signs.

modelo-dossie.atmosfera: A serious, investigative mood with a vintage, high-premium feel, evoking a meticulously assembled case.
modelo-dossie.elementoVisual: A dark corkboard filled with various paper documents (manila folders, reports, index cards, newspaper clippings, post-it notes, photos, phone screenshots) pinned to it. These elements are rendered flat with subtle shadows and connected by a thin, twisted accent line. The hero sentence is integrated into one or more of these documents, acting as a central piece of evidence or a key finding.
composicoes: The hero text is a large title on a central report document, surrounded by smaller supporting documents and accent lines on the dark corkboard background.
The hero text is on a manila folder in the lower third, with a key visual element (photo or screenshot) pinned above it, and accent lines pointing to both.
The hero text is split across multiple small index cards and post-it notes, arranged diagonally across the center of the post, with accent lines forming a web.
A single, large visual element (e.g., a stylized screenshot or photo) fills most of the frame, with the hero text overlaid as a prominent title on a report document pinned to its lower edge.
The hero text is presented as a stamped verdict on a central memo, with the dark corkboard visible around it, and smaller, less detailed documents pinned in the background.
modelo-dossie.tipografia: Sora (a geometric sans-serif) is used for all readable text: heavy weight for titles, stamps, and numbers; medium-heavy for items and names; and medium for supporting text. Special Elite (a typewriter font) is reserved for short, uppercase labels with wide tracking. Permanent Marker is used only for question marks on post-it notes.
modelo-dossie.textura: The background is a dark, textured corkboard with subtle lighting. Paper elements have a fine grain texture and cast soft shadows, never showing any shine.
modelo-dossie.luz: The scene is lit from above with a focused, warm light source, creating a subtle vignette effect with darker edges and top, emphasizing the center.
modelo-dossie.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, with light, warm-toned papers for documents and dark text. A single, distinct accent color is used exclusively for connecting lines and stamps.
modelo-dossie.evitar: Never include numbers, names, or data not explicitly stated in the sentence, using a censor bar instead. Avoid any real logos or brand names, and never use the accent color outside of lines and stamps.

modelo-espelho.atmosfera: Discreet luxury, high-end magazine aesthetic. Calm, meaningful, and meticulously designed.
modelo-espelho.elementoVisual: A symmetrical, line-art illustration, reminiscent of an atlas engraving, stands on a horizontal dividing line. Key areas within the illustration are highlighted with a dotted texture and a filled circle, corresponding to keywords from the hero sentence. The illustration is generic and adaptable to any subject, filling the space where a video presenter would be.
composicoes: Hero text is centered, large, and occupies the top half of the post; the visual element is small, centered at the bottom, and anchored to the dividing line.
Hero text is aligned left in a top panel; the visual element is large, filling the right side of the post, with its base on the dividing line.
Hero text is in a narrow left column, small and stacked; the visual element is large, filling the entire right side of the post, with its base on the dividing line.
Hero text is a single, very large word or number, centered over the top half of the post; the visual element is a medium-sized, centered illustration, with its base on the dividing line.
Hero text is a short phrase at the bottom left; the visual element is a large, central illustration, dominating the post, with its base on the dividing line.
modelo-espelho.tipografia: Elegant, high-contrast serif typeface for titles, items, and numbers, with italic variants for emphasis and notes. A wide-tracked uppercase geometric sans-serif is used for small labels and units. Text sizes vary significantly, from large headlines to small labels, ensuring clear hierarchy.
modelo-espelho.textura: Clean, smooth surfaces dominate, with the only texture being a subtle dotted pattern used to highlight specific areas within the visual element.
modelo-espelho.luz: Even, soft, and diffused lighting creates a premium, studio-like feel, emphasizing clarity and subtle depth.
modelo-espelho.papeisDasCores: A light, warm background dominates, with dark text and line art. A single, rich accent color is used sparingly for dividing lines, highlights, and key points, with a slightly darker variant for text on the light background.
modelo-espelho.evitar: Do not include any gradients, shadows, glows, text outlines, emojis, stickers, or stock photos. Avoid any elements that would carry additional text beyond the hero sentence, such as price tags, signs, or screens.

modelo-estudio.atmosfera: Professional, modern, and high-production, evoking a premium podcast or broadcast feel. The overall atmosphere is focused and intense.
modelo-estudio.elementoVisual: A subject-related abstract or conceptual image, scene, or texture fills a rectangular frame with slightly rounded corners. This element is rendered as a stylized 3D graphic, a flat illustration, or a photographic texture, always generic and adaptable to any topic. It serves as a visual anchor, replacing the presenter's video feed.
composicoes: Hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with the visual element filling the top two-thirds of the post, leaving ample negative space.
Hero text is positioned in a prominent left column, with the visual element filling the right two-thirds of the post, creating a strong vertical division.
Hero text is integrated within the visual element, with key words highlighted, and the element fills the entire post, using negative space within its composition.
Hero text is small and positioned at the top, with the visual element filling the bottom three-quarters of the post, creating a sense of scale and depth.
Hero text is large and centered over a smaller visual element placed at the bottom, with the top two-thirds of the post as dark background.
modelo-estudio.tipografia: A robust, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif is used for titles, numbers, and key phrases, with variations in weight for hierarchy. A monospaced, all-caps sans-serif is used for smaller, functional labels, maintaining tight letter spacing for a technical feel.
modelo-estudio.textura: Surfaces are smooth and clean, with a subtle, almost imperceptible gradient on the dark background, suggesting depth without overt grain or paper textures.
modelo-estudio.luz: The scene is lit with a dramatic, high-contrast setup, featuring a dominant dark background and a single, focused accent light that highlights key elements.
modelo-estudio.papeisDasCores: The background is predominantly dark, almost black, with text in a warm light tone. A single vibrant accent color is used sparingly for highlights and active elements, never tinting photos.
modelo-estudio.evitar: Do not include any elements that suggest a video interface, such as play buttons, progress bars, or time markers. Avoid any visual elements that would require additional text beyond the hero sentence, like empty signs or labels.

modelo-etapas.atmosfera: Structured, informative, and direct. It conveys a modern, premium feel for educational content.
modelo-etapas.elementoVisual: The primary visual element is a static screenshot or a stylized illustration of a digital interface, such as a web page, application, or data table. This element serves as 'proof on screen' for the hero text, filling a designated area of the canvas.
composicoes: Hero text is large and centered at the top, with the visual element filling the bottom two-thirds of the post, cropped to show relevant detail.
Hero text is small and positioned in a thin column on the left, with the visual element occupying the entire right two-thirds of the post, shown at a medium scale.
Hero text is large and centered over the top half of a full-bleed visual element, which is rendered with a slightly desaturated or blurred effect to ensure legibility.
Hero text is small and aligned to the bottom right, with the visual element presented as a large, detailed close-up filling the top three-quarters of the post.
Hero text is centered horizontally in the middle of the post, with the visual element appearing as a smaller, contained rectangle above it, and ample negative space below.
modelo-etapas.tipografia: A robust, geometric sans-serif typeface is used throughout. Key words in the hero text are rendered in a heavy weight, uppercase, with light tracking, while supporting text uses a medium weight, lowercase, with standard tracking.
modelo-etapas.textura: Surfaces are clean and smooth, with no visible grain or paper texture. The overall impression is digital and polished.
modelo-etapas.luz: The scene is evenly lit with a cool, neutral light, ensuring clarity and legibility of all elements without harsh shadows or strong highlights.
modelo-etapas.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates the post, with light text for high contrast. A single warm accent color is used sparingly for emphasis or small graphic elements.
modelo-etapas.evitar: Do not use any animated transitions, glowing effects, or colored words. Avoid any elements that appear 'too edited' or overly decorative, maintaining a clean and functional aesthetic.

modelo-etiqueta.atmosfera: Informative and comparative, guiding the viewer through tiered options. The aesthetic is clean, practical, and premium, reminiscent of a well-organized retail display.
modelo-etiqueta.elementoVisual: A stylized, multi-tiered shelf structure, rendered as a 2D illustration or collage, occupies the upper portion of the post. Each tier features a subject-related image or graphic card, with a hanging price tag and a 'what changes' strip. A 'worth it?' meter and a 'best value' seal are integrated into the composition.
composicoes: Hero text is centered at the bottom, with the multi-tiered shelf filling the upper two-thirds of the post, featuring a prominent 'best value' seal.
Hero text is aligned to the top left, with the shelf structure scaled down slightly and shifted to the right, allowing for negative space on the left.
Hero text is large and centered over the middle tier of the shelf, which is scaled to fill most of the post, with other tiers visible in the background.
Hero text is positioned in a narrow column on the far left, with the shelf structure extending across the rest of the post, showcasing all tiers equally.
Hero text is placed at the bottom right, with a single, enlarged tier of the shelf dominating the upper left, highlighting one specific option with its price tag and 'what changes' strip.
modelo-etiqueta.tipografia: A single, wide, and rounded geometric sans-serif family is used throughout. Key information like prices, labels, and main text uses a heavy weight (800), while details use a medium-heavy weight (600-700). Text is never condensed or outlined, maintaining clear legibility.
modelo-etiqueta.textura: The background features a subtle perforated panel texture. Labels and cards have a paper-like texture with soft edges. Shelf components have a smooth, light wood grain texture.
